content.title: AirPods Pro 3 6-Months Later! Honest Long-Term Review!
content.text: It’s been nearly 6 months since Apple released the AirPods Pro 3 — and it’s time for an honest, long-term review. In this video, I break down what’s actually improved, what hasn’t changed much, and which new feature I haven’t used at all. We’ll talk about the upgraded ANC performance, new foam ear tips, battery life changes (including the controversial case downgrade), improved Ultra Wideband tracking, and whether heart rate sensing is actually useful. Thank you to Lexar for sponsoring this video! Grab the Lexar ES5 Magnetic SSD! 👉 https://bit.ly/4huDX0Z 🏷️ Grab AirPods Pro 3 on sale: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0FQFB8FMG?... I’ve flown extensively with these — including using them with Apple Vision Pro — and I’ll share how they’ve performed in real-world travel, workouts, and daily use. Plus, with the same H2 chip as AirPods Pro 2, is there really enough here to justify upgrading? If you’re deciding between AirPods Pro 2 and AirPods Pro 3 — or wondering if they’re worth it in 2026 — this is the review you need. If you want to stay up to date with all the latest Apple news and reviews, make sure you subscribe! Let me know in the comments: • Are you using heart rate sensing? • Have you noticed the improved ANC? • Is the battery case downgrade a dealbreaker?
